notes: EBIT is modeled using Dow’s reported Operating EBIT (non-GAAP) definition from its Operating EBIT reconciliation (excludes significant items). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))

NWC is computed from balance-sheet components using: (Total current assets − cash & cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − notes payable − long-term debt due within one year). This excludes cash and short-term debt to align with typical invested-capital DCF conventions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))
WACC is set as an assumption (0.085) because a company-provided WACC metric was not directly extracted from the provided primary sources used here.

Comps EV/NTM revenue is approximated using the source’s LTM EV/Revenue where true EV/NTM revenue was not available in the peer table; this is flagged as a proxy limitation. ([balmoraladvisors.com](https://balmoraladvisors.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2025-Q1-Chemicals-Balmoral-Advisors.pdf))

catalysts: Evidence of margin stabilization and improved operating rates as the cycle moves from 2025 trough conditions to normalization.

Execution of cost actions and operating-model simplification translating into sustained Operating EBIT improvement. ([investors.dow.com](https://investors.dow.com/en/news/news-details/2026/Dow-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results/default.aspx))

Capital allocation outcomes (capex timing and project execution) affecting free-cash-flow generation through the cycle. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Dow Inc. is a global chemicals and materials company serving packaging, infrastructure/industrial intermediates, and specialty applications.
Dow reports operating performance using Operating EBIT (non-GAAP) and has highlighted cost actions and operating model simplification as key levers.
The company’s capital program remains significant, and working-capital dynamics can swing with pricing and demand cycles.
current_context: Full-year 2025 net sales were $40.0 billion, with Operating EBIT down to $0.4 billion versus $2.6 billion in 2024; cash provided by operating activities—continuing operations was $1.1 billion. ([investors.dow.com](https://investors.dow.com/en/news/news-details/2026/Dow-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results/default.aspx))

Management emphasized progress on near-term cash/cost support actions (including accelerated cost savings) and stated expectations for at least $2 billion in additional near-term earnings. ([investors.dow.com](https://investors.dow.com/en/news/news-details/2026/Dow-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results/default.aspx))
2025 cash returns included dividends of ~$1.5 billion. ([investors.dow.com](https://investors.dow.com/en/news/news-details/2026/Dow-reports-fourth-quarter-2025-results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case assumes a cyclic recovery in profitability (Operating EBIT margin rising from depressed 2025 levels toward a normalized mid-cycle margin). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))

Forecast maintains a roughly steady capital intensity and depreciation structure, consistent with historical D&A and capex levels. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))

Working-capital intensity is normalized (NWC as a percent of sales returns toward mid-cycle), supporting more predictable free-cash-flow conversion. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1751788/000175178826000018/dow-20251231.htm))

Valuation triangulation uses sector EV/EBITDA forward multiples and forward P/E snapshots from major market-data summaries. ([balmoraladvisors.com](https://balmoraladvisors.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2025-Q1-Chemicals-Balmoral-Advisors.pdf))
key_risks: Prolonged commodity/chemical price weakness and weaker-than-modeled demand could delay operating-margin recovery.
Working-capital pressure (receivables/inventory dynamics) could reduce free-cash-flow versus modeled NWC intensity.
Higher-than-assumed tax or input-cost volatility could pressure effective profitability and cash taxes.
